excerpt: MakersClaw is a workspace of ready-made apps, each with its own AI agent and scheduled jobs, plus an agent that builds new apps from a sentence. 3-day trial, then from $23 a month billed yearly. Pricing, how credits work and alternatives.
content:
MakersClaw is a workspace where apps come with AI agents built in. Its App Store lists more than 40 apps, such as a CRM, issue tracker, wiki, content calendar, blog post studio, weekly planner and rank tracker, and each app has an agent that can run scheduled jobs, for example drafting a weekly plan every Monday or a content report every Friday. A company wiki holds what your business knows, and every app and agent reads it. If no app fits, you can describe what you need and MakersClaw builds a new app or changes an existing one.

MakersClaw connects to more than 1,000 tools, and all plans include every app and every AI model; plans differ in monthly credits, which pay for agent work such as building an app, answering a question or running a scheduled job. Smarter models use more credits per step. When it launched on Product Hunt, MakersClaw described itself as AI employees that live in Slack, Teams and Telegram; its site now presents it as an app store and workspace for teams.

MakersClaw is operated by Cogaid Solutions Private Limited of Howrah, West Bengal, according to its imprint. It launched on Product Hunt on 16 June 2026 and finished #3 for the day with 417 upvotes and 60 comments.

We have not tested MakersClaw ourselves. This page brings together MakersClaw's website, pricing page and imprint, its Product Hunt page, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.starts_at: 3-day trial; User plan $23/month billed yearly ($29 monthly)
profile.summary_short: Workspace of apps with built-in AI agents and scheduled jobs, plus an agent that builds new apps

gallery.alt: MakersClaw graphic 'Start with a goal. Build from there.' with tiles for apps, agents and automations
MakersClaw chat turning 'Help me launch my startup' into a research agent, launch planner and weekly update
MakersClaw App Store with mini apps such as resume builder, pitch builder, cold email and founder LinkedIn
MakersClaw graphic 'The AI OS for your startup' showing its desktop-style workspace

use_cases: Replacing several separate tools (CRM, wiki, planner, issue tracker) with apps in one workspace
Scheduling agents to draft weekly plans, project health checks or content reports
Drafting blog posts, LinkedIn posts and newsletters from your own wiki and activity
Building a custom internal app by describing it in a sentence

fit: are a founder or small team that wants many work apps with AI agents in one place
want agents to run recurring jobs on a schedule
want to build small internal tools without code
not_fit: want to try it without a card: the trial needs one and converts to a paid plan unless cancelled
need deep, specialised features of tools like Salesforce or Jira
need predictable costs with heavy use of top models, which use more credits

pricing.intro: Every MakersClaw plan includes every app, model and feature; plans differ in monthly credits. Prices are in US dollars before tax from MakersClaw's pricing page. Launch graphics mentioned 10,000 free credits for one person; the current page offers a 3-day trial with a card instead.

plans.name: User
plans.detail: 15,000 credits a month; every app with its agent, scheduled jobs, 1,000+ tool connections, company wiki

plans.name: Builder
plans.detail: 35,000 credits a month; live preview, safe edits with rollback, websites on your own domain

plans.name: Max
plans.detail: From 72,000 credits a month, lowest cost per credit, early access

notes: 3-day free trial on Individual plans; a card is required and you are charged when the trial ends unless you cancel.
Business plans (Team and Scale) need a work email and a claimed company domain; Enterprise is by arrangement.
Monthly credits do not roll over; top-up credits never expire.

alternatives.intro: Product Hunt lists Taskade, Pickaxe and GPTBots.ai among MakersClaw's alternatives. Review scores are Product Hunt users' own; check each tool's pricing page for current prices.

items.name: Taskade
items.what: AI workspace that builds apps, agents and automations from a prompt
items.difference: A similar prompt-to-app workspace; MakersClaw leads with a store of ready-made apps that each carry an agent.

items.name: Pickaxe
items.what: Build AI agents and sell them
items.difference: Aimed at building agents to sell to others; MakersClaw is a team workspace.

items.name: GPTBots.ai
items.what: Platform for building AI agent teams for businesses
items.difference: Agent and bot builder for businesses rather than a store of work apps.

alternatives.more: Product Hunt also lists BetterClaw and Skydive.

pros: Every plan includes every app and every model
Agents run scheduled jobs inside each app
Build or change apps by describing them
cons: Credits run down faster on smarter models
Positioning has shifted since launch, so older descriptions may not match the product
No independent reviews on Product Hunt yet

x.none: We found no posts about MakersClaw on X to link yet.

faq.a: A workspace of more than 40 apps, each with its own AI agent and scheduled jobs, plus an agent that builds new apps from a description.
User is $23 a month billed yearly ($29 monthly), Builder $47 ($59) and Max from $95 ($119). There is a 3-day trial that needs a card.
Agent work such as building or changing an app, answering a question or running a scheduled job. Smarter models use more credits per step.
Its imprint names Cogaid Solutions Private Limited, based in Howrah, West Bengal, India.
Product Hunt lists Taskade, BetterClaw, Pickaxe, Skydive and GPTBots.ai.
